direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible routes, state glow on real state change, layered depth and cinematic 240ms route trace then static; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; no unrelated loops; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls, never conflating them; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with animated flow direction, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; depth via floor plane, machine scale and soft emerald state glow

Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls in the side zone; keep Verified findings as evidence only.
Add emerald flow and glow only to the three feasible paths in the SVG, with silver idle machines, so findings visibly map to the scene on hover and focus.
Enlarge the 3 / 0 / 3 metric labels to 12px minimum and link each verified fact bidirectionally to its station node.
Make Select this path selection state unmistakable in both side zone and scene cards, then surface one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall as the single primary progression.
Add state glow and a single 240ms route trace to the chosen feasible route, respecting reduced motion.
Keep No acceptance recorded in plain silver text until selection, reserving emerald fill for the enabled Review action.

Keep the silver cross-hatched WILL GO OFFLINE preview, x marker and plain OFFLINE wording; add a hatched preview also inside the CELL-MILL-2 side-zone row for pattern-plus-text redundancy.

Mark CELL-MILL-2 in the scene with silver cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE beside replan required, matching steps 6 and 7 instead of a plain silver card.
Clarify the coexistence state in one 16px line: 3 BLOCKED prior tasks, approved revised plan, 3 proposed replacements awaiting approval and untracked until approval.
Untruncate the third proposed task title within its card so judges can read the full replacement work without interaction.
Condense the right evidence column inside its reserved zone so Verify, Seal and Retain controls fit at 1366x768 without inspector scrolling; shorten checklist copy to one 16px instruction.
Connect the 01-02-03 timeline with a cinematic emerald trace to the active Verify ledger card and silver dashed links to locked stages.
Raise the small passphrase helper text to at least 12px and pair the primary Verify ledger button with an aria-live result region.
